title: 離子束光學表面修形
summary: 從氬離子濺射的原子級去除出發，建立高斯去除函數、駐留時間反卷積與空間頻率上限的概念，再把離子源、柵極、真空與基板熱負載、干涉量測對位、誤差預算與驗收紀錄串成一條可重複的確定性修形流程。
summaryEn: Starting from atomic-scale removal by argon-ion sputtering, build the Gaussian removal function, dwell-time deconvolution and spatial-frequency limit, then chain ion source, grids, vacuum, substrate thermal load, interferometer registration, error budget and acceptance record into a repeatable deterministic figuring process.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 確定性修形練習：直徑 300 mm 熔融石英平面，初始面形 25 nm RMS、120 nm PV。去除函數為高斯，峰值 R₀ = 1.0 nm/s、FWHM = 10 mm，σ = 4.25 mm，體積去除率 = R₀·2πσ² = 1.0 × 113 = 113 nm·mm²/s。假設修正需要的平均去除深度為 70 nm（高於最低點的平均高度 60 nm 加 10 nm 底層），工件面積 π×150² = 70,686 mm²，總體積 70 × 70,686 = 4.95×10⁶ nm·mm²，修形時間 ≈ 4.95×10⁶/113 ≈ 43,800 s ≈ 12.2 h；加上 21% 邊緣溢出約 14.8 h。誤差預算：束流穩定 1% × 70 nm = 0.7 nm、量測 0.5 nm、對位 0.3 mm × 1 nm/mm = 0.3 nm、週期小於 20 mm 的不可修正中頻 2 nm，殘差 ≈ √(0.7² + 0.5² + 0.3² + 2²) ≈ 2.2 nm RMS，收斂 91%。熱平衡：束流 1000 V × 40 mA = 40 W，7.8 kg 石英（密度 2.2 g/cm³，熱容約 5.8 kJ/K）若不散熱每小時升溫 40×3600/5800 ≈ 25 K，所以必須靠夾具導熱與限制電流把穩態溫升壓在 30 K 以下。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何機台規格。
workedExample.textEn: Deterministic-figuring exercise: a 300 mm diameter fused-silica flat with initial figure 25 nm RMS and 120 nm PV. The removal function is Gaussian with peak R₀ = 1.0 nm/s and FWHM = 10 mm, so σ = 4.25 mm and the volumetric rate = R₀·2πσ² = 1.0 × 113 = 113 nm·mm²/s. Assume the correction needs a mean removal of 70 nm (60 nm mean height above the lowest point plus a 10 nm floor); the part area is π×150² = 70,686 mm², the total volume 70 × 70,686 = 4.95×10⁶ nm·mm², and the figuring time ≈ 4.95×10⁶/113 ≈ 43,800 s ≈ 12.2 h, about 14.8 h with 21% edge overrun. Error budget: beam stability 1% × 70 nm = 0.7 nm, metrology 0.5 nm, registration 0.3 mm × 1 nm/mm = 0.3 nm, uncorrectable mid-frequency below a 20 mm period 2 nm, residual ≈ √(0.7² + 0.5² + 0.3² + 2²) ≈ 2.2 nm RMS, a 91% convergence. Thermal balance: beam power 1000 V × 40 mA = 40 W; without cooling the 7.8 kg silica part (density 2.2 g/cm³, heat capacity about 5.8 kJ/K) would warm by 40×3600/5800 ≈ 25 K per hour, so fixture conduction and current limits must hold the steady-state rise below 30 K. All values are teaching assumptions, not any machine's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

steps.title: 濺射去除的物理與去除率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Sputter removal physics and removal rate: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「氬離子束與工件表面」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離子束修形用能量約 0.5 到 1.5 keV 的氬離子轟擊光學表面，離子把動量傳給近表面原子，形成碰撞級聯，部分原子獲得足以脫離表面的能量而被濺射出去。每個入射離子平均濺射出的原子數稱為濺射產率 Y，對熔融石英在 1 keV 附近約為 1 個原子，去除深度只由離子通量、產率與材料原子密度決定。因為沒有機械接觸，不存在拋光壓力造成的邊緣效應與工具磨耗，整個過程在真空中進行，去除量以奈米為單位可預測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氬離子束與工件表面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ion-beam figuring bombards the optical surface with argon ions of roughly 0.5 to 1.5 keV; each ion transfers momentum to near-surface atoms, starting a collision cascade in which some atoms gain enough energy to leave the surface. The mean number of atoms ejected per incident ion is the sputter yield Y, about 1 atom per ion for fused silica near 1 keV, so removal depth is set only by ion flux, yield and atomic density. With no mechanical contact there is no pressure-driven edge effect and no tool wear; the process runs in vacuum and removal is predictable in nanometres. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：去除深度速率 ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n，其中 j 為離子電流密度、n 為原子密度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Depth removal rate ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n with j the ion current density and n the atomic density.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離子束像砂輪一樣，壓得越用力去除越快。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An ion beam removes faster when pressed harder, like a grinding wheel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「氬離子束與工件表面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sputter removal physics and removal rate" is correct?
options: 離子束像砂輪一樣，壓得越用力去除越快。

steps.title: 濺射去除的物理與去除率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sputter removal physics and removal rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「氬離子束與工件表面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：去除深度速率 ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n，其中 j 為離子電流密度、n 為原子密度。熔融石英 n = 3ρN_A/M = 3×2.2×6.022×10²³/60.08 ≈ 6.6×10²² 原子/cm³；取 Y = 1.0、j = 1 mA/cm²，離子通量 j/e = 6.24×10¹⁵ 離子/(cm²·s)，ṙ ≈ 6.24×10¹⁵/6.6×10²² ≈ 9.4×10⁻⁸ cm/s ≈ 0.94 nm/s，約 56 nm/min；產率隨入射角在 60° 到 70° 附近達到最大。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Depth removal rate ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n with j the ion current density and n the atomic density. For fused silica n = 3ρN_A/M = 3×2.2×6.022×10²³/60.08 ≈ 6.6×10²² atoms/cm³; with Y = 1.0 and j = 1 mA/cm² the ion flux j/e = 6.24×10¹⁵ ions/(cm²·s) gives ṙ ≈ 6.24×10¹⁵/6.6×10²² ≈ 9.4×10⁻⁸ cm/s ≈ 0.94 nm/s, about 56 nm/min; the yield peaks near 60° to 70° incidence. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同材料試片上讓離子束靜止駐留固定時間（例如 180 s），用干涉儀或輪廓儀量出凹坑深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，與上述公式用量測到的束流密度估算值比較；再以 0°、30°、60° 入射角重複，記錄產率隨角度的變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Hold the beam stationary on a witness sample of the same material for a fixed time such as 180 s, measure the crater depth and shape with an interferometer or profilometer, divide depth by time to get the peak removal rate, and compare with the formula using the measured beam current density; repeat at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to record the angular dependence of the yield.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.question: 依「濺射去除的物理與去除率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sputter removal physics and removal rate", which statement holds?
options: 離子束修形是冷加工，不需要考慮工件溫度。
多迭代幾次，離子束修形的殘差就能無限趨近於零。
去除深度速率 ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n，其中 j 為離子電流密度、n 為原子密度。
optionsEn: Ion-beam figuring is a cold process, so workpiece temperature can be ignored.
With enough iterations ion-beam figuring drives the residual arbitrarily close to zero.
Depth removal rate ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n with j the ion current density and n the atomic density.
quiz.explanation: 去除深度速率 ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n，其中 j 為離子電流密度、n 為原子密度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Depth removal rate ṙ = Y·(j/e)/n with j the ion current density and n the atomic density. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 濺射去除的物理與去除率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sputter removal physics and removal rate: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「氬離子束與工件表面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在同材料試片上讓離子束靜止駐留固定時間（例如 180 s），用干涉儀或輪廓儀量出凹坑深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，與上述公式用量測到的束流密度估算值比較；再以 0°、30°、60° 入射角重複，記錄產率隨角度的變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Hold the beam stationary on a witness sample of the same material for a fixed time such as 180 s, measure the crater depth and shape with an interferometer or profilometer, divide depth by time to get the peak removal rate, and compare with the formula using the measured beam current density; repeat at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to record the angular dependence of the yield. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把從熔融石英量到的去除率直接套到碳化矽或微晶玻璃，產率差異會讓實際去除量與駐留時間圖不符，修形後面形不但沒有收斂反而出現與誤差圖同形的殘差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Applying a removal rate measured on fused silica to silicon carbide or glass ceramic lets the yield difference desynchronise actual removal from the dwell map; the figure fails to converge and leaves a residual shaped like the original error map.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「濺射去除的物理與去除率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sputter removal physics and removal rate"?
options: 在同材料試片上讓離子束靜止駐留固定時間（例如 180 s），用干涉儀或輪廓儀量出凹坑深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，與上述公式用量測到的束流密度估算值比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
離子束可以直接修正任何粗拋後的表面，前段拋光品質不重要。
optionsEn: Hold the beam stationary on a witness sample of the same material for a fixed time such as 180 s, measure the crater depth and shape with an interferometer or profilometer, divide depth by time to get the peak removal rate, and compare with the formula using the measured beam current density.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
An ion beam can directly correct any coarsely polished surface, so the preceding polish quality does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 在同材料試片上讓離子束靜止駐留固定時間（例如 180 s），用干涉儀或輪廓儀量出凹坑深度與形狀，深度除以時間得到峰值去除率，與上述公式用量測到的束流密度估算值比較；再以 0°、30°、60° 入射角重複，記錄產率隨角度的變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Hold the beam stationary on a witness sample of the same material for a fixed time such as 180 s, measure the crater depth and shape with an interferometer or profilometer, divide depth by time to get the peak removal rate, and compare with the formula using the measured beam current density; repeat at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to record the angular dependence of the yield. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 濺射去除的物理與去除率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sputter removal physics and removal rate: failure diagnosis

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gaussian removal function and dwell-time map” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離子束在工件上的去除分佈稱為去除函數（beam removal function），通常近似高斯，半高全寬由柵極光學與工作距離決定，約 3 到 30 mm。修形時束流以固定功率在面上掃描，實際去除量等於去除函數與駐留時間圖的二維卷積，因此已知誤差圖後必須反卷積求出非負的駐留時間，常用 Richardson–Lucy 或帶非負約束的最小平方法。高斯函數在頻域也是高斯，空間週期短於束寬的誤差幾乎無法被修正，這決定了離子束修形只能處理低頻面形，中高頻必須由前段拋光控制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高斯去除函數與駐留時間圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The removal distribution of the beam on the workpiece is the beam removal function, usually near Gaussian with a full width at half maximum set by grid optics and working distance, about 3 to 30 mm. During figuring the beam scans the surface at constant power, and actual removal equals the two-dimensional convolution of the removal function with the dwell-time map, so the error map must be deconvolved into a non-negative dwell map with Richardson–Lucy or non-negative least squares. A Gaussian is also Gaussian in the frequency domain, so errors with periods shorter than the beam width are barely correctable; ion-beam figuring therefore handles low-frequency figure only, and mid and high frequencies must be controlled by the preceding polish. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gaussian removal function and dwell-time map”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：去除函數 R(r) = R₀·exp(−r²/2σ²)，σ = FWHM/2.355；FWHM = 10 mm 時 σ = 4.25 mm，體積去除率 R₀·2πσ² = 1 nm/s × 113 mm² = 113 nm·mm²/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Removal function R(r) = R₀·exp(−r²/2σ²) with σ = FWHM/2.355; for FWHM = 10 mm, σ = 4.25 mm and the volumetric rate R₀·2πσ² = 1 nm/s × 113 mm² = 113 nm·mm²/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要駐留時間夠長，任何空間頻率的誤差都能被離子束修掉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：去除函數 R(r) = R₀·exp(−r²/2σ²)，σ = FWHM/2.355；FWHM = 10 mm 時 σ = 4.25 mm，體積去除率 R₀·2πσ² = 1 nm/s × 113 mm² = 113 nm·mm²/s。其頻率響應 H(f) = exp(−2π²σ²f²)：週期等於 FWHM（f = 0.1 mm⁻¹）時 H ≈ 0.028，週期 20 mm 時 H ≈ 0.41，週期 40 mm 時 H ≈ 0.80，所以可修正週期約需大於 3 倍束寬。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Removal function R(r) = R₀·exp(−r²/2σ²) with σ = FWHM/2.355; for FWHM = 10 mm, σ = 4.25 mm and the volumetric rate R₀·2πσ² = 1 nm/s × 113 mm² = 113 nm·mm²/s. Its frequency response H(f) = exp(−2π²σ²f²) gives H ≈ 0.028 for a period equal to the FWHM (f = 0.1 mm⁻¹), H ≈ 0.41 at a 20 mm period and H ≈ 0.80 at 40 mm, so correctable periods need to exceed roughly 3 beam widths. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把量到的誤差圖做功率譜密度分析，用 H(f) 預測每個頻段修形後的殘餘量，再與實際修形後的 PSD 比較；同時用去除函數與駐留時間圖重新卷積，確認模擬去除量與干涉儀量到的前後差異在幾個奈米內一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the power spectral density of the measured error map, predict the post-figuring residual per band with H(f), and compare with the PSD measured after the run; also re-convolve the removal function with the dwell map and confirm that the simulated removal matches the interferometric before-and-after difference within a few nanometres.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 離子源、柵極光學與真空環境：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ion source, grid optics and vacuum environment: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「柵極離子源與中和器」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gridded ion source and neutralizer” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 修形機的核心是 Kaufman 型柵極離子源：放電室以燈絲或射頻把氬氣游離成電漿，屏蔽柵與加速柵之間的電位差把離子抽出並加速到設定能量，兩片柵極的孔徑對準與間距決定束流發散與去除函數寬度。束流離開後由熱燈絲或電漿橋中和器注入電子，避免絕緣的玻璃工件表面充電而使束流偏折。腔體工作壓力約 10⁻⁴ mbar，比離子平均自由徑對應的壓力低，使離子在抵達工件前幾乎不碰撞；真空品質、氣體流量與柵極溫度都影響束流穩定度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「柵極離子源與中和器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The heart of the machine is a Kaufman-type gridded ion source: a discharge chamber ionises argon with a filament or RF antenna, the potential between screen and accelerator grids extracts and accelerates ions to the set energy, and the alignment and gap of the two grids set beam divergence and removal-function width. A hot-filament or plasma-bridge neutralizer injects electrons into the beam so the insulating glass workpiece does not charge and deflect it. The chamber operates near 10⁻⁴ mbar, low enough that ions rarely collide before reaching the part; vacuum quality, gas flow and grid temperature all affect beam stability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gridded ion source and neutralizer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：柵極抽取電流受 Child–Langmuir 空間電荷限制 j_max = (4ε₀/9)·√(2e/m)·V^{3/2}/d²。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「提高柵極電壓就能無限制地提高束流密度與去除率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Raising grid voltage increases beam current density and removal rate without limit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「柵極離子源與中和器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 離子源、柵極光學與真空環境：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ion source, grid optics and vacuum environment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「柵極離子源與中和器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gridded ion source and neutralizer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：柵極抽取電流受 Child–Langmuir 空間電荷限制 j_max = (4ε₀/9)·√(2e/m)·V^{3/2}/d²。氬離子 √(2e/m) ≈ 2.2×10³ (C/kg)^{1/2}，V = 1000 V、柵距 d = 1 mm 時 j_max ≈ 3.9×10⁻¹² × 2.2×10³ × 3.16×10⁴ / 10⁻⁶ ≈ 270 A/m² ≈ 27 mA/cm²，實際抽取值只有此上限的一部分。另外 10⁻⁴ mbar 下氬的平均自由徑約 0.7 m，遠大於 0.2 m 的工作距離。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The extractable grid current is bounded by the Child–Langmuir space-charge limit j_max = (4ε₀/9)·√(2e/m)·V^{3/2}/d². At 10⁻⁴ mbar the argon mean free path is about 0.7 m, far beyond a 0.2 m working distance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用法拉第杯陣列或單一法拉第杯掃描束流剖面，取得電流密度分佈與半高全寬，並與靜止凹坑的去除函數比對；連續記錄束流電流、放電電壓與腔壓一小時，確認電流漂移在 ±1% 內，中和器開關前後工件表面電位差小於數十伏。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan the beam profile with a Faraday-cup array or a single Faraday cup to obtain the current-density distribution and full width at half maximum, and compare with the stationary-crater removal function; log beam current, discharge voltage and chamber pressure for an hour to confirm current drift within ±1% and a surface-potential change below tens of volts when the neutralizer is switched on.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 離子源、柵極光學與真空環境：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ion source, grid optics and vacuum environment: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「柵極離子源與中和器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Gridded ion source and neutralizer” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用法拉第杯陣列或單一法拉第杯掃描束流剖面，取得電流密度分佈與半高全寬，並與靜止凹坑的去除函數比對；連續記錄束流電流、放電電壓與腔壓一小時，確認電流漂移在 ±1% 內，中和器開關前後工件表面電位差小於數十伏。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan the beam profile with a Faraday-cup array or a single Faraday cup to obtain the current-density distribution and full width at half maximum, and compare with the stationary-crater removal function; log beam current, discharge voltage and chamber pressure for an hour to confirm current drift within ±1% and a surface-potential change below tens of volts when the neutralizer is switched on. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：柵極受熱變形或孔徑錯位會讓束流偏斜與展寬，去除函數不再是校正時的高斯形，整張駐留時間圖隨之失效；中和器失效時玻璃表面累積正電荷，束流被排斥而去除率驟降且不均勻。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Thermally warped or misaligned grids skew and broaden the beam so the removal function no longer matches the calibrated Gaussian and the whole dwell map is invalid; a failed neutralizer lets positive charge build on the glass, repelling the beam so removal collapses and becomes non-uniform.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.instruction: 離子束修形把束流功率的大部分變成工件的熱：1 keV 離子停在表面下僅 2 到 3 nm，能量以熱的形式沉積，而玻璃的熱導率只有約 1.3 W/(m·K)，真空中又只能靠輻射與夾具傳導散熱，所以大型工件在長時間修形中會升溫數十度。材料對濺射的反應也不同：熔融石英為均質玻璃，修形後粗糙度幾乎不變；微晶玻璃含有奈米級結晶相與玻璃相，兩相濺射速率不同，深度去除後粗糙度可能從 0.3 nm 上升到 1 nm 等級，因此前段拋光必須先把誤差壓到數百奈米以內以限制去除深度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「基板材料與熱負載」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.observation: 量級提示：穩態溫升估計：束流功率 P = 1000 V × 40 mA = 40 W 平均落在直徑 300 mm 的工件上，面功率密度 q = 40/0.0707 ≈ 566 W/m²；若只靠兩面輻射散熱，線性化輻射係數 4εσT³ ≈ 4×0.9×5.67×10⁻⁸×293³ ≈ 5.1 W/(m²·K)，兩面共 10.3 W/(m²·K)，ΔT ≈ 566/10.3 ≈ 55 K；夾具傳導可把它壓低，但顯示束流電流必須配合散熱設計。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Steady-state temperature-rise estimate: beam power P = 1000 V × 40 mA = 40 W averaged over a 300 mm diameter part gives q = 40/0.0707 ≈ 566 W/m²; with radiation from both faces only, the linearised radiative coefficient 4εσT³ ≈ 4×0.9×5.67×10⁻⁸×293³ ≈ 5.1 W/(m²·K), 10.3 W/(m²·K) for two faces, so ΔT ≈ 566/10.3 ≈ 55 K; fixture conduction lowers this, but it shows that beam current must match the cooling design.

steps.instruction: 在工件背面貼熱電偶或用紅外測溫，記錄整個修形過程的溫度曲線，與功率平衡估計比較；修形前後用白光干涉儀與 AFM 量同一區域的粗糙度與 PSD，確認高頻段沒有因差異濺射而上升，微晶玻璃工件另外檢查表面是否出現結晶相造成的顆粒狀紋理。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 面形量測、座標對位與去除函數校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Figure metrology, coordinate registration and removal-function calibration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「干涉儀誤差圖與機台座標對位」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Interferometer error map and machine registration” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 修形的輸入是干涉儀量到的面形誤差圖，它必須以基準記號或邊緣偵測對位到機台的掃描座標，位置誤差會乘上局部斜率變成去除誤差。去除函數必須在每次修形前以靜止凹坑實測，而不是沿用舊值，因為柵極老化、氣流與工作距離變化都會改變峰值速率與寬度。干涉儀本身的重複性、參考面誤差與空氣擾動設定了可達到的面形下限，所以量測需平均多幀並扣除參考面。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「干涉儀誤差圖與機台座標對位」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The input to figuring is the interferometric error map, which must be registered to the machine scan coordinates with fiducials or edge detection; a position error multiplied by the local slope becomes a removal error. The removal function must be re-measured with a stationary crater before every run rather than reused, because grid ageing, gas flow and working-distance changes alter both peak rate and width. Interferometer repeatability, reference-surface error and air turbulence set the attainable figure floor, so measurements are averaged over many frames with the reference subtracted. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Interferometer error map and machine registration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：靜止駐留 180 s 得到凹坑深度 180 nm，峰值去除率 R₀ = 1.00 nm/s，凹坑剖面擬合 FWHM = 9.8 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 180 s stationary dwell yields a crater depth of 180 nm, so the peak rate R₀ = 1.00 nm/s, and a fit to the crater profile gives FWHM = 9.8 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「去除函數是機台常數，校正一次就能長期使用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The removal function is a machine constant that needs calibrating only once." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「干涉儀誤差圖與機台座標對位」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Interferometer error map and machine registration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 面形量測、座標對位與去除函數校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Figure metrology, coordinate registration and removal-function calibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「干涉儀誤差圖與機台座標對位」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Interferometer error map and machine registration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：靜止駐留 180 s 得到凹坑深度 180 nm，峰值去除率 R₀ = 1.00 nm/s，凹坑剖面擬合 FWHM = 9.8 mm。若束流在運行中漂移 2%，對 150 nm 的去除深度造成 3 nm 誤差；若對位誤差 0.5 mm 而局部斜率 10 nm/mm，則去除位置誤差帶來 5 nm；干涉儀 16 幀平均的重複性約 0.5 nm RMS。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 180 s stationary dwell yields a crater depth of 180 nm, so the peak rate R₀ = 1.00 nm/s, and a fit to the crater profile gives FWHM = 9.8 mm. A 2% beam drift during the run produces a 3 nm error on a 150 nm removal; a 0.5 mm registration error on a local slope of 10 nm/mm adds 5 nm; a 16-frame interferometer average repeats to about 0.5 nm RMS. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以兩次獨立安裝量測同一工件並相減，RMS 差值除以 √2 作為量測重複性；在工件邊緣刻意製作一個已知位置的小凹坑，修形後檢查凹坑與誤差圖的座標偏移量，確認對位誤差小於 0.3 mm。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the same part in two independent mountings and subtract; the RMS of the difference divided by √2 is the measurement repeatability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Interferometer error map and machine registration” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以兩次獨立安裝量測同一工件並相減，RMS 差值除以 √2 作為量測重複性；在工件邊緣刻意製作一個已知位置的小凹坑，修形後檢查凹坑與誤差圖的座標偏移量，確認對位誤差小於 0.3 mm。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the same part in two independent mountings and subtract; the RMS of the difference divided by √2 is the measurement repeatability. steps.observation: 注意干擾：沿用上個月的去除函數而柵極已老化，峰值速率低了 15%，一次修形後殘差仍與原誤差圖同形只是縮小；誤差圖左右鏡像裝反，修形反而把誤差加倍。

steps.title: 誤差預算與收斂極限：原理與系統邊界

steps.objective: 說明「修形誤差預算表」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Figuring error budget table” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 一次修形後的殘差來自幾個互相獨立的來源：量測重複性、去除率漂移乘以去除深度、對位誤差乘以斜率、反卷積無法修正的中頻成分，以及工件邊緣束流溢出造成的邊緣效應。因為各項獨立，總殘差以均方根相加；去除率與對位項正比於本次去除深度，所以第二次迭代時它們自動縮小，最後收斂到由中頻與量測底限決定的平台。理解這個結構才能判斷再多做一次迭代是否值得。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「修形誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The residual after one run comes from several independent sources: measurement repeatability, rate drift times removal depth, registration error times slope, the mid-spatial-frequency content that deconvolution cannot correct, and the edge effect from beam overrun at the part boundary. Being independent, they add root-sum-square; the rate and registration terms scale with the removal depth of that run, so they shrink automatically in the second iteration, and the process converges to a floor set by mid-frequency content and the metrology limit. Understanding this structure tells you whether another iteration is worth running. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Figuring error budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：第一次迭代：量測 0.5 nm、去除率 2%×150 nm = 3 nm、對位 1 nm、不可修正中頻 2 nm，殘差 ≈ √(0.5² + 3² + 1² + 2²) = √14.25 ≈ 3.8 nm RMS，從 25 nm 起算收斂 85%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: First iteration: metrology 0.5 nm, rate 2%×150 nm = 3 nm, registration 1 nm, uncorrectable mid-frequency 2 nm, residual ≈ √(0.5² + 3² + 1² + 2²) = √14.25 ≈ 3.8 nm RMS, an 85% convergence from 25 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多迭代幾次，離子束修形的殘差就能無限趨近於零。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With enough iterations ion-beam figuring drives the residual arbitrarily close to zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：第一次迭代：量測 0.5 nm、去除率 2%×150 nm = 3 nm、對位 1 nm、不可修正中頻 2 nm，殘差 ≈ √(0.5² + 3² + 1² + 2²) = √14.25 ≈ 3.8 nm RMS，從 25 nm 起算收斂 85%。第二次迭代去除深度降到約 15 nm，去除率項 0.3 nm，殘差 ≈ √(0.25 + 0.09 + 0.01 + 4) ≈ 2.1 nm，已由中頻項主導。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each iteration decompose the residual map by band and compare low- and mid-frequency RMS: the low band should shrink as budgeted while the mid band stays nearly constant; a rising mid band points to beam instability or raster-pitch problems.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

quiz.question: 要驗證「誤差預算與收斂極限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Error budget and convergence limit"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
離子束修形是冷加工，不需要考慮工件溫度。
每次迭代後把殘差圖做頻段分解，比較低頻段與中頻段 RMS 的變化：低頻應按預算縮小，中頻應幾乎不變。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Ion-beam figuring is a cold process, so workpiece temperature can be ignored.
After each iteration decompose the residual map by band and compare low- and mid-frequency RMS: the low band should shrink as budgeted while the mid band stays nearly constant.
quiz.explanation: 每次迭代後把殘差圖做頻段分解，比較低頻段與中頻段 RMS 的變化：低頻應按預算縮小，中頻應幾乎不變；若中頻段反而上升，表示束流穩定度或掃描步距有問題；把實測收斂率與預算預測值列在同一張表中追蹤。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After each iteration decompose the residual map by band and compare low- and mid-frequency RMS: the low band should shrink as budgeted while the mid band stays nearly constant; a rising mid band points to beam instability or raster-pitch problems. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 誤差預算與收斂極限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Error budget and convergence limit: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「修形誤差預算表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Figuring error budget table” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把所有殘差歸咎於機台而反覆迭代，實際上殘差已由不可修正的中頻主導，多做三次迭代只多花十幾小時並增加熱負載與粗糙度，面形沒有進一步改善。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Blaming the machine for all residual and iterating repeatedly when the residual is already mid-frequency dominated costs tens of hours, more thermal load and more roughness with no figure improvement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：理解這個結構才能判斷再多做一次迭代是否值得。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Understanding this structure tells you whether another iteration is worth running.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「多迭代幾次，離子束修形的殘差就能無限趨近於零。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「與拋光製程鏈整合及掃描策略」與「驗收規格換算與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Integration with the polishing chain and scan strategy" and "Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 與拋光製程鏈整合及掃描策略：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Integration with the polishing chain and scan strategy: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「製程鏈與熱平衡等待」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Process chain and thermal settling” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離子束修形位於製程鏈的末端：研磨與傳統拋光先給出低粗糙度與受控的中頻，磁流變或小工具拋光把面形壓到數百奈米，最後才由離子束做奈米級收斂，之後清洗、鍍膜。掃描策略決定邊緣處理：為了讓邊緣也獲得正確去除，駐留時間圖必須延伸到工件外一到兩個束寬，這段溢出時間是純粹的成本。修形後工件溫度高於環境，低膨脹材料雖然變形小，但量測仍需等待熱平衡，否則面形圖內含熱梯度項。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「製程鏈與熱平衡等待」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ion-beam figuring sits at the end of the chain: grinding and conventional polishing deliver low roughness and controlled mid-frequency, magnetorheological or small-tool polishing brings figure to a few hundred nanometres, and only then does the ion beam provide nanometre convergence, followed by cleaning and coating. The scan strategy governs edge handling: for correct removal at the rim the dwell map must extend one to two beam widths beyond the part, and that overrun time is pure cost. After the run the part is warmer than ambient; even a low-expansion material must settle thermally before measurement or the map contains a thermal-gradient term. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Process chain and thermal settling”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：直徑 300 mm、厚 50 mm 的微晶玻璃質量 ≈ 2530 kg/m³ × 3.53×10⁻³ m³ ≈ 8.9 kg，熱容 ≈ 8.9×800 ≈ 7.1 kJ/K；出腔後在空氣中以 h ≈ 10 W/(m²·K)、面積 0.19 m² 散熱，時間常數 τ ≈ 7100/1.9 ≈ 3700 s ≈ 1 h，從 27 K 溫差降到 0.1 K 需 ln(270)·τ ≈ 5.6×3700 s ≈ 5.8 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 300 mm diameter, 50 mm thick glass-ceramic part has mass ≈ 2530 kg/m³ × 3.53×10⁻³ m³ ≈ 8.9 kg and heat capacity ≈ 8.9×800 ≈ 7.1 kJ/K; cooling in air with h ≈ 10 W/(m²·K) over 0.19 m² gives a time constant τ ≈ 7100/1.9 ≈ 3700 s ≈ 1 h, so settling from a 27 K excess to 0.1 K takes ln(270)·τ ≈ 5.6×3700 s ≈ 5.8 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離子束可以直接修正任何粗拋後的表面，前段拋光品質不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An ion beam can directly correct any coarsely polished surface, so the preceding polish quality does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「製程鏈與熱平衡等待」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Process chain and thermal settling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 與拋光製程鏈整合及掃描策略：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Integration with the polishing chain and scan strategy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「製程鏈與熱平衡等待」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Process chain and thermal settling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：直徑 300 mm、厚 50 mm 的微晶玻璃質量 ≈ 2530 kg/m³ × 3.53×10⁻³ m³ ≈ 8.9 kg，熱容 ≈ 8.9×800 ≈ 7.1 kJ/K；出腔後在空氣中以 h ≈ 10 W/(m²·K)、面積 0.19 m² 散熱，時間常數 τ ≈ 7100/1.9 ≈ 3700 s ≈ 1 h，從 27 K 溫差降到 0.1 K 需 ln(270)·τ ≈ 5.6×3700 s ≈ 5.8 h。邊緣溢出：束寬 10 mm、延伸 15 mm，掃描面積由 π×150² 增為 π×165²，多出 21% 的時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 300 mm diameter, 50 mm thick glass-ceramic part has mass ≈ 2530 kg/m³ × 3.53×10⁻³ m³ ≈ 8.9 kg and heat capacity ≈ 8.9×800 ≈ 7.1 kJ/K; cooling in air with h ≈ 10 W/(m²·K) over 0.19 m² gives a time constant τ ≈ 7100/1.9 ≈ 3700 s ≈ 1 h, so settling from a 27 K excess to 0.1 K takes ln(270)·τ ≈ 5.6×3700 s ≈ 5.8 h. Edge overrun: with a 10 mm beam extended 15 mm, the scanned area grows from π×150² to π×165², about 21% more time. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄工件出腔後每 30 分鐘的干涉圖，追蹤像散與離焦項隨時間的衰減，直到連續兩次量測差異小於 1 nm RMS 才視為熱平衡；比較邊緣 10 mm 環帶與中心區的殘差 RMS，確認溢出策略有效且沒有邊緣塌陷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record an interferogram every 30 minutes after the part leaves the chamber and track the decay of astigmatism and defocus until two consecutive maps differ by less than 1 nm RMS, which defines thermal settling; compare residual RMS in the outer 10 mm annulus with the central zone to confirm the overrun strategy works and there is no edge roll.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 與拋光製程鏈整合及掃描策略：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Integration with the polishing chain and scan strategy: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「製程鏈與熱平衡等待」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Process chain and thermal settling” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 記錄工件出腔後每 30 分鐘的干涉圖，追蹤像散與離焦項隨時間的衰減，直到連續兩次量測差異小於 1 nm RMS 才視為熱平衡；比較邊緣 10 mm 環帶與中心區的殘差 RMS，確認溢出策略有效且沒有邊緣塌陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record an interferogram every 30 minutes after the part leaves the chamber and track the decay of astigmatism and defocus until two consecutive maps differ by less than 1 nm RMS, which defines thermal settling; compare residual RMS in the outer 10 mm annulus with the central zone to confirm the overrun strategy works and there is no edge roll. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了省時間不做邊緣溢出，邊緣一圈去除不足，面形在最外 10 mm 出現向上翹的環帶；工件未熱平衡就量測，把熱離焦誤當成面形誤差餵回下一次駐留時間圖，修形後反而出現相反符號的球差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Skipping the edge overrun to save time under-removes the rim and leaves an upturned annulus in the outer 10 mm; measuring before thermal settling feeds thermal defocus into the next dwell map as if it were figure, and the run then imprints spherical error of the opposite sign.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 與拋光製程鏈整合及掃描策略：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Integration with the polishing chain and scan strategy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「製程鏈與熱平衡等待」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Process chain and thermal settling” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了省時間不做邊緣溢出，邊緣一圈去除不足，面形在最外 10 mm 出現向上翹的環帶；工件未熱平衡就量測，把熱離焦誤當成面形誤差餵回下一次駐留時間圖，修形後反而出現相反符號的球差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping the edge overrun to save time under-removes the rim and leaves an upturned annulus in the outer 10 mm; measuring before thermal settling feeds thermal defocus into the next dwell map as if it were figure, and the run then imprints spherical error of the opposite sign. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：修形後工件溫度高於環境，低膨脹材料雖然變形小，但量測仍需等待熱平衡，否則面形圖內含熱梯度項。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: After the run the part is warmer than ambient; even a low-expansion material must settle thermally before measurement or the map contains a thermal-gradient term.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「離子束可以直接修正任何粗拋後的表面，前段拋光品質不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An ion beam can directly correct any coarsely polished surface, so the preceding polish quality does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 驗收規格換算與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「驗收報告與交接資料包」如何決定離子束光學表面修形的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acceptance report and handoff package” determines the key performance of “Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 驗收不是只看一個 PV 數字：規格通常以波長分數給出，必須換算成表面 RMS 並說明是否已扣除傾斜與離焦、使用的濾波頻寬與取樣密度。反射鏡的表面誤差在波前上加倍，Maréchal 判準給出 Strehl 0.8 所需的波前 RMS 約 λ/14，可反推表面容許值。交接資料包應包含最終面形圖與 Zernike 係數、各頻段 PSD、修形前後粗糙度、去除函數校正紀錄、駐留時間圖與總去除深度，以及鍍膜前清洗建議，讓下游能追溯每一項數據的來源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收報告與交接資料包」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance is more than one PV number: specifications are usually given as a wavelength fraction and must be converted to surface RMS with a statement of whether tilt and focus were removed, the filter bandwidth and the sampling density. A mirror's surface error doubles in the wavefront, and the Maréchal criterion requires about λ/14 RMS wavefront for a Strehl ratio of 0.8, from which the surface allowance follows. The handoff package should contain the final map with Zernike coefficients, band-limited PSDs, roughness before and after, the removal-function calibration record, the dwell map and total removal depth, plus a pre-coating cleaning recommendation, so downstream users can trace every figure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance report and handoff package”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：規格 λ/20 PV（633 nm）= 31.7 nm PV；對隨機誤差 RMS ≈ PV/5 ≈ 6.3 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A λ/20 PV specification at 633 nm is 31.7 nm PV; for random error RMS ≈ PV/5 ≈ 6.3 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「PV 越小越好，一個 PV 數字就足以描述面形品質。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A single PV number fully describes figure quality, and smaller is always better." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「驗收報告與交接資料包」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Acceptance report and handoff package”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 驗收規格換算與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收報告與交接資料包」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance report and handoff package” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：規格 λ/20 PV（633 nm）= 31.7 nm PV；對隨機誤差 RMS ≈ PV/5 ≈ 6.3 nm。反射使用時波前 RMS = 2×6.3 = 12.7 nm，Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×12.7/633)²] ≈ exp(−0.0159) ≈ 0.984。離子束修形常達到 2 nm RMS 表面，對應波前 4 nm，Strehl ≈ 0.998；總去除深度紀錄 70 nm，對 Ar 佈植深度 3 nm 的表層需在鍍膜前清洗。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A λ/20 PV specification at 633 nm is 31.7 nm PV; for random error RMS ≈ PV/5 ≈ 6.3 nm. Used in reflection the wavefront RMS = 2×6.3 = 12.7 nm and Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π×12.7/633)²] ≈ exp(−0.0159) ≈ 0.984. Ion-beam figuring commonly reaches 2 nm RMS surface, 4 nm wavefront, Strehl ≈ 0.998; a recorded total removal of 70 nm leaves a 3 nm argon-implanted skin that must be cleaned before coating. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立的第二台干涉儀或不同參考面量測最終面形，兩者差異需小於規格的五分之一；核對交接資料包中每個數值的量測條件（波長、濾波、對位）是否一致，並確認鍍膜廠接收的清洗方式不會改變面形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the final figure on an independent second interferometer or against a different reference; the two must agree to within one fifth of the specification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 驗收規格換算與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收報告與交接資料包」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acceptance report and handoff package” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以獨立的第二台干涉儀或不同參考面量測最終面形，兩者差異需小於規格的五分之一；核對交接資料包中每個數值的量測條件（波長、濾波、對位）是否一致，並確認鍍膜廠接收的清洗方式不會改變面形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the final figure on an independent second interferometer or against a different reference; the two must agree to within one fifth of the specification. Check that every number in the package carries consistent measurement conditions (wavelength, filtering, registration) and that the cleaning process the coating shop will use does not alter the figure. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把扣除了傾斜與離焦後的 RMS 當成全口徑 PV 報給客戶，驗收時用不同濾波重新量測而不合格；缺少去除函數與駐留時間紀錄，日後面形異常時無法追溯是量測、機台還是材料的問題。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Reporting a tilt-and-focus-removed RMS as if it were full-aperture PV fails acceptance when the customer re-measures with different filtering; without the removal-function and dwell records a later figure anomaly cannot be traced to metrology, machine or material.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

quiz.question: 要驗證「驗收規格換算與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff"?

With enough iterations ion-beam figuring drives the residual arbitrarily close to zero.
quiz.explanation: 以獨立的第二台干涉儀或不同參考面量測最終面形，兩者差異需小於規格的五分之一；核對交接資料包中每個數值的量測條件（波長、濾波、對位）是否一致，並確認鍍膜廠接收的清洗方式不會改變面形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the final figure on an independent second interferometer or against a different reference; the two must agree to within one fifth of the specification. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 驗收規格換算與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Acceptance specification conversion and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收報告與交接資料包」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Acceptance report and handoff package” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把扣除了傾斜與離焦後的 RMS 當成全口徑 PV 報給客戶，驗收時用不同濾波重新量測而不合格；缺少去除函數與駐留時間紀錄，日後面形異常時無法追溯是量測、機台還是材料的問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Reporting a tilt-and-focus-removed RMS as if it were full-aperture PV fails acceptance when the customer re-measures with different filtering; without the removal-function and dwell records a later figure anomaly cannot be traced to metrology, machine or material. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接資料包應包含最終面形圖與 Zernike 係數、各頻段 PSD、修形前後粗糙度、去除函數校正紀錄、駐留時間圖與總去除深度，以及鍍膜前清洗建議，讓下游能追溯每一項數據的來源。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff package should contain the final map with Zernike coefficients, band-limited PSDs, roughness before and after, the removal-function calibration record, the dwell map and total removal depth, plus a pre-coating cleaning recommendation, so downstream users can trace every figure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「PV 越小越好，一個 PV 數字就足以描述面形品質。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A single PV number fully describes figure quality, and smaller is always better." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 把扣除了傾斜與離焦後的 RMS 當成全口徑 PV 報給客戶，驗收時用不同濾波重新量測而不合格；缺少去除函數與駐留時間紀錄，日後面形異常時無法追溯是量測、機台還是材料的問題。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「驗收規格換算與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
